primitives.name: Matchup Risk Tensor

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{T}_{ij}': 'tensor element representing probability of outcome i given matchup j', 'outcome_i': 'player performance category (e.g., low, medium, high)', 'matchup_j': 'defensive strength category (e.g., weak, average, strong)'}
primitives.assumptions: Matchups can be categorized and outcomes modeled probabilistically.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When player is returning from surgery or facing unexpected defensive strength.
